scenario_title: Multi-Format Document Ingestion to Grounded Q&A
preconditions: Authenticated tenant session; empty document repository
inputs_triggers: Upload PDF (sample.pdf) and post natural language query
expected_behavior: Response contains evidence-grounded answer with verified page citations and character offsets. Zero hallucinated references.

preconditions: Standard two-column PDF with embedded multi-column financial table
expected_behavior: Elements extracted with Kendall tau >= 0.80; table cells reconstructed with F1 >= 0.90. Headers and cells properly associated.

preconditions: Candidate chunk pool totaling 8000 tokens; hard budget limit 2048 tokens
release_gate: Selected context strictly <= 2048 tokens. Submodular knapsack ratio >= 0.316 verified against greedy optimum.

preconditions: Document containing legal definitions; question asking about unrelated medical treatment
expected_behavior: System returns status='abstained' and abstention rationale. No fabricated or unverified claims.

preconditions: Two vendor master agreements uploaded with differing payment terms ($50k net 30 vs $75k net 60)
expected_behavior: System identifies conflicting terms preserves both source spans and generates typed ConflictReportModel. Neither value silently overwritten.

preconditions: Pending review item generated from extracted fact candidate
inputs_triggers: Reviewer claims item (POST /v1/reviews/{id}/claim) submits approved decision with rationale
expected_behavior: Status transitions pending -> in_review -> approved. Stale version submissions rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict.

inputs_triggers: Attacker attempts UPDATE or DELETE on audit trail table or endpoint
expected_behavior: All direct modifications rejected. Audit log maintains cryptographic append-only event sequence with timestamp and actor ID.

preconditions: Long-running extraction job queued; worker process terminated mid-execution
inputs_triggers: Worker killed via SIGKILL while holding lease. Recovery scanner invoked.
expected_behavior: Lease heartbeat expires; job returned to queued status and processed by recovery worker. Dead-letter queue on max retries.

preconditions: Tenant A uploads sensitive NDA; Tenant B attempts retrieval using Tenant A document ID
expected_behavior: Request denied with HTTP 404 Not Found (non-disclosing). Zero cross-tenant data or metadata leakage in SQLite/FAISS.

inputs_triggers: User loads documents navigates chunks queries Q&A and executes review approvals
expected_behavior: Standalone HTML5 SPA functions without external CDNs. All API requests authenticated via local tenant context switcher.
